about: Thresholds for explaining one product's position. scripts/visibility_explain.py reads this file. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.page_size: Products on the first page. A product ranked deeper than this is 'not on page one' (also --page-size).
notes.compare_window: How many products ranked directly above the target are compared with it (their median relevance and performance).
notes.relevance_gap_ratio: The target's relevance below this share of the median of the products above it is a relevance gap (the text match is weaker).
notes.performance_gap_ratio: The target's performance score below this share of the median of the products above it is a performance gap (fewer views, add-to-carts, orders or revenue).
notes.max_rows_per_call: Largest rows value to request from search_discovery_product_grid_insights; rows=500 and above return HTTP 500, so page through for more.
